method: git subtree add (no squash) on the pull request branch; the repository merges squash-only, so .github/workflows/ensemble-catchup.yml links the source history to main afterwards (git merge -s ours, no file changes)
catch_up: dispatch .github/workflows/ensemble-catchup.yml (qnfo-research-exec does it while the history is unlinked or the legacy repository has newer cycles); by hand: git fetch https://github.com/QNFO/qnfo-ensemble-research main && git merge -s ours --allow-unrelated-histories <source_head> && git merge -Xsubtree=runs FETCH_HEAD
